chunks.text_en:
BEACH
Approximately 250 meters of pebble and sandy shoreline. Beach towel exchange is free of charge (exchanged at certain times with a towel card). Sun loungers, umbrellas, restrooms, showers, and changing rooms are available. Daybeds (reserved and paid) are also offered. Blue Flag certification.

POOL AND WATER PARK
Activity Pool: 1,720 m³ / 1,227 m² / Depth: 130 - 140 cm / Tiled surface  
Relax Pool & Adults Only (+16): 509 m³ / 364 m² / 140 cm / Tiled surface  
Oasis Pool: 562 m³ / 402 m² / 140 cm / Tiled surface  
Children’s Pool (within MyMo Club, with 1 water slide): 78 m³ / 112 m² / 70 cm / Tiled surface  
Baby Pool (within MyMo Club): 11 m³ / 27 m² / 40 cm / Tiled surface  
Adult Water Park (with 4 water slides): 170 m³ / 142 m² / 120 cm / Tiled surface  
Children’s Water Park (with 5 water slides): 225 m³ / 170 m² / 35 cm / Tiled surface

Beach towel exchange is free of charge (exchanged at certain times with a towel card).  
Sun loungers cannot be reserved in pools before 09:00.  
There is no indoor pool.  
Pools are not heated.

Türkiye'yi ziyaret ederken Türk hamamına zaman ayırmak şart ve METT Hotel & Beach Resort Bodrum, mükemmel bir deneyim için özel odaların eklenmesiyle hem karma hem de kadınlara özel alanlar sunuyor. Tuz odası, buhar odası, sauna ve ısı kontrollü havuz içermektedir.Raise FitnessRAISE Fitness & Wellness'ın odak noktası kapsayıcı fitness deneyimleri sunmak ve fiziksel egzersizi dengeli bir yaşam tarzına dahil etmek isteyen geniş bir nüfusa hitap etmektir. RAISE güçlü bir topluluk hissine sahiptir ve burayı ait olduğunuzu hissettiğiniz bir yer haline getirir. RAISE, herkes arasında bir topluluk duygusu yaratmak için şefkat ve kabul üzerine inşa edilmiş davetkar bir ortamdır. Sağlığa bütünsel bir yaklaşımla RAISE, tüm benliğin ihtiyaçlarını, tutkularını ve arzularını ele alır. Ruh hali parlak, basit ve zariftir. Asla çok gürültülü veya çok agresif değildir. Asla çok sıkıcı ya da çok sessiz değildir. Doğal hissettiriyor, basit, kolay.Su SporlarıMETT Plaj bölgesinde elverişli bir konumda yer alan su sporları ve aktiviteler tek kullanımlık! Jet Ski, parasailing, paddleboard, wake board, su kayağı gibi motorlu ve motorsuz seçenekleriyle. Banana rafts, Ringo's, So METT Plaj bölgesinde elverişli bir konumda yer alan su sporları ve aktiviteler tek kullanımlık! Jet Ski, parasailing, paddleboard, wake board, su kayağı gibi motorlu ve motorsuz seçenekleriyle. Banana rafts, Ringo's, Sonar ve Air Stream gibi aileler veya arkadaş grupları için (2 ila 8 kişiye kadar) uygun grup aktiviteleri içermektedir. Su sporları kabini ayrıca Bodrum yarımadasında tekne gezileri ve Bodrum Marina'ya deniz taksisi hizmeti sunmaktadır. Su sporları eğlencesi her yaş için uygundur.
chunks.text_en:
MOI Spa
No holiday experience is complete without balancing excitement and relaxation. MOI Spa spans 850 square meters of indoor space, where skilled therapists assist you in choosing the best thermal treatments tailored to your personal preferences. These treatments are designed to soothe, pamper, de-stress, and invigorate your mind and body. While visiting Turkey, taking time for a Turkish bath is a must, and METT Hotel & Beach Resort Bodrum offers both mixed and women-only areas with the addition of private rooms for an exceptional experience. The spa features a salt room, steam room, sauna, and a temperature-controlled pool.

Raise Fitness
RAISE Fitness & Wellness aims to provide inclusive fitness experiences and incorporate physical exercise into a balanced lifestyle for a broad audience. RAISE fosters a strong sense of community, making you feel like you belong. Built on compassion and acceptance, it offers a welcoming environment where everyone can feel connected. With a holistic approach to health, RAISE addresses the needs, passions, and desires of the whole self. The atmosphere is bright, simple, and elegant—never too loud or aggressive, nor boring or too quiet. It feels natural, straightforward, and easy.

Water Sports
Located conveniently in the METT Beach area, water sports and activities are available on a single-use basis! Options include motorized activities like jet skiing, parasailing, wakeboarding, and waterskiing, as well as non-motorized options such as paddleboarding. Group activities suitable for families or friends (up to 2 to 8 people) include banana rafts, Ringo rides, Sonar, and Air Stream. The water sports booth also offers boat trips around the Bodrum Peninsula and sea taxi services to Bodrum Marina. Water sports fun is suitable for all ages.

chunks.text_en:
The hotel features 3 restaurants and 1 bar. Martı Hemithea Hotel offers restaurants and bars with different concepts, each serving very special flavors. 

Lobby Lounge & Terrace
Breakfast is served at the Lobby Lounge and on the terrace. In addition to a rich breakfast prepared with local and homemade ingredients, the Lobby Lounge also offers a snack menu and alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages throughout the day. Outside the summer season, lunch and dinner are served by the fireplace in the Lobby Lounge.

Mistral Restaurant
Nestled among pine trees with a stunning view of Hisarönü Bay, the Club Mistral Restaurant & Bar is renowned both in Turkey and internationally, attracting its own loyal followers. It offers a selection of exquisite dishes from Mediterranean and world cuisines all day long.

Yacht Club & Bar
The Yacht Club & Bar is a meeting place not only for hotel guests but also for sea lovers and boat owners, providing food and drinks throughout the day.

Martı Patisserie
Martı Patisserie is a delightful spot for both boat owners and hotel guests, offering freshly baked daily bread, croissants, pastries, cakes, and cookies. It also serves a variety of ice creams along with hot and cold non-alcoholic beverages.

Spa and Beauty Center  
With its services, the SPA brings the legend of the Goddess Hemithea to life. Located within a bamboo forest and accompanied by the scent of pine, the SPA offers treatments both indoors and outdoors, covering an area of 250 square meters. In this mystical atmosphere, trained experts provide classic body and regional massages, therapies, aromatherapy, anti-cellulite treatments, relaxing massages, Thai massages, baths, seaweed and mud baths, and skin care.  

Additionally, in the 48 square meter Turkish bath and relaxation area, traditional bath culture developed over thousands of years is offered through enhanced programs in a comfortable and hygienic environment. The Turkish bath features a private kese (exfoliation) room, as well as a sauna and steam room within the spa.  

Events and Celebrations  
The garden and poolside event areas provide an ideal setting for weddings and other celebrations during the summer months, tailored to guests' desires.

BEACH & POOLS

- 1 hotel pool and 2 club pools (each with designated children's areas)
- 1 indoor pool
- 3 children's pools (one with a slide)
- Mini-Club

Sun loungers, umbrellas, and beach towels are provided free of charge.

CACTUS BEACH

chunks.text_en:
The hotel features 3 restaurants and 4 bars. Food & Beverage includes a buffet breakfast, late breakfast, open buffet lunch and dinner. Themed buffets are held on certain evenings of the week. There are snack restaurants at specific times of the day. The pastry corner offers tea time with a variety of cakes and dry pastries. The all-inclusive program is valid from 10:00 to 24:00, during which alcoholic and non-alcoholic local drinks at the specified bars and restaurants are free of charge. Ice cream service is available. The minibar is replenished daily with cola, Fanta, soft drinks, water, soda, and canned beer. Freshly squeezed fruit juices, all imported alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, cocktails, and bottled drinks at bars and restaurants are chargeable. Alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks served in bars are provided in glasses and cups at the table; bottled service is not available. There are two à la carte restaurants: Turkish cuisine "Sultan" and Mediterranean cuisine "Turkuaz" (reservations required / extra charge). Due to hygiene rules, food cannot be taken out from the restaurants. Alcoholic beverages are not served to guests under 18 years old. Proper attire is mandatory in the restaurants.

RESTAURANTS & BARS
The Riviera main restaurant offers breakfast and dinner as open buffets. The Marmaid Restaurant provides lunch and snack services. There is a baby corner equipped with a microwave, bottle warmer, and sterilizer, as well as baby chairs (subject to availability). The Sultan and Turkuaz à la carte restaurants are available with prior reservation and additional charges. The lobby lounge bar, Siesta pool bar, and beach bar are also available.

FOOD CORNER
Within the new food corner concept, four types of fresh, hot, and delicious foods are served daily.

ICE CREAM & FRUIT STAND
A new ice cream and fruit stand offers a variety of treats.

The open buffet breakfast, late breakfast, open buffet lunch and dinner are available. Themed buffets are held on certain evenings of the week. There are snack restaurants at specific times of the day. The pastry corner offers tea time with a variety of cakes and dry pastries. The all-inclusive program is valid from 10:00 to 24:00, during which alcoholic and non-alcoholic local drinks at the specified bars and restaurants are free of charge. Ice cream service is available. The minibar is replenished daily with cola, Fanta, soft drinks, water, soda, and canned beer.

The beach is wide, flat, and covered with fine, soft sand, measuring 120 meters. Sunbeds, umbrellas, and cushions are provided free of charge.  
Pools:  
Open Swimming Pool: 900 m² with a depth of 140 cm (accessible via steps).  
Indoor Swimming Pool: 100 m² with a depth of 140 cm (only open during the winter season).  
Children's Pool: 35 cm deep.  
There are 3 water slides available at certain hours.  
Sunbeds, umbrellas, and cushions are free of charge.  
To change your beach towel, you must return used towels to the spa center by 19:00 and collect your towel cards.  
You can receive new towels once daily between 08:30 and 11:00 at no additional cost.  

Pavilion Concept:  
For the new Pavilion service, reservations can be made through Guest Relations for an additional fee.

The hotel is located 450 meters from the sea and has its own private beach. There are 24 private wooden pavilions, which are available for an additional fee. Sunbeds, umbrellas, and beach towels are provided free of charge. During the summer season, a shuttle service runs every 15 minutes from 08:30 to 00:00 to the beach, and this service is free. The sea is shallow, and the beach features a mixture of fine sand and pebbles.

POOL INFORMATION
The pools are open from 08:00 to 19:00. The beachfront outdoor swimming pools include:
- Pool 1: 1,220 m²
- Pool 2: 180 m²
- Children's outdoor pool 1: 100 m²
- Pool 3: 600 m²
The hotel’s outdoor pools are:
- Pool 1: 730 m²
- Heated outdoor pool: 77 m²
- Children's outdoor pool: 50 m²
The indoor and heated swimming pool covers 180 m², and there is a small indoor children's pool of 7 m². The facility also features a 9-lane water park. The indoor heated pool is only open during the winter months.

The property has a private beach that is 150 meters wide, with a mixture of sand and pebbles. There is a pier on the beach. Additionally, there are 24 beach pavilions available for rent, with waiter service provided. Sunbeds, umbrellas, and beach towels are free of charge. Shuttle service to the beach runs every 15 minutes from 08:00 to 00:00. Beach lounges (pavilions) are available from 10:00 to 18:00 for an additional fee, and reservations are required.

The indoor pool at the facility is only available during the winter season. Foot washing and disinfection stations have been added at pool entrances; these areas are regularly cleaned and the water is frequently changed. The chlorine level in our pools has been increased to between 1 ppm and 1.5 ppm. All sunbeds and common areas are meticulously disinfected throughout the day by our disinfection team. To ensure personal hygiene, all sunbeds around the beach and pool are covered with disposable covers. All beach towels are individually packaged and served to guests. 

Our children are our most valuable assets, and ensuring they have a fun and safe holiday is as important to us as it is to you. Therefore, in addition to the dedicated playrooms, kids' club, and playground areas within the facility, we have implemented the following measures:

- Children are admitted to the kids' club by reservation and will have their temperatures taken and recorded upon entry.
- Since wearing shoes inside the kids' club is not hygienic, all children will be provided with disposable slippers at the entrance.
- Toys used within the kids' club will be disinfected daily after closing.

The restaurant has indoor and outdoor areas with a capacity of 850 people (including the adults-only section). It offers a variety of delicious dishes in open buffet style for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Water, table wine, beer, and non-alcoholic beverages are complimentary. Table reservations are not accepted.

Pasha on the Bay Restaurant – À La Carte Mediterranean Cuisine  
If you are seeking a romantic dinner for two at Hillside Beach Club, Pasha on the Bay is the perfect venue. The restaurant offers an à la carte Mediterranean menu exclusively for adults during dinner hours. Reservations are required in advance.  

Pasha on the Bay operates every evening except Sunday (subject to weather conditions) and serves drinks at an additional charge. Children under 12 are not accepted. For those who prefer a late start to their day, Pasha also offers a "light late breakfast" every morning from 10:30 to 12:00.

Beach Bar & Restaurant – À La Carte Italian Cuisine  
During the daytime, Beach Bar & Restaurant provides a snack buffet for those who prefer not to leave the beach. In the evenings, it enriches the Mediterranean atmosphere with exquisite Italian dishes paired with a selection of local and international wines. Reservations are required for dinner. The restaurant operates according to weather conditions (except Wednesday dinner), and drinks are charged separately.

Restaurants and Bars

Barbarossa Beach Restaurant
A beachside restaurant offering all-day service of Aegean seafood, light meals, and snacks. *Closed during the winter season.

Olives Restaurant
Experience contemporary Turkish cuisine with a gastronomic touch. Enjoy a buffet breakfast and à la carte dinner. Guests can indulge in the freshest, highest quality local flavors and live cooking stations. Reservation system available for families with children.

Pool Restaurant & Bar
A seasonal à la carte poolside restaurant and bar. Savor Mediterranean and international light snacks and dishes, along with specially crafted cocktails, smoothies, and frozen drinks in a unique setting.

Bar Blue
Enjoy extraordinary cocktails, Turkish and international wines, and champagnes while taking in the breathtaking views of Barbaros Bay. Perfect for pre- and post-dinner drinks with a stunning sunset backdrop.

Chill Out Lounge
A relaxing space by the infinity pool, offering a peaceful retreat.

Saigon Restaurant
Discover a new world on your plate at Saigon Restaurant with a menu that surprises and delights your palate. Exotic Pan-Asian flavors paired with fusion cocktails or a selection of fine wines from our cellar will surely ignite your adventurous spirit.

Villa Rossa Restaurant
Enjoy the comfort of a home-away-from-home at Villa Rossa. Located within the peaceful surroundings of Barbarossa Reserve Residences, this special area features fresh, seasonal ingredients and our chef’s impeccable touch.

FOOD AND BEVERAGE SERVICES Standard Complimentary Services: Midi bar (refreshed once daily) / Water, Cola, Diet Cola, Fanta, Beer, Soda, Fruit juice, Milk (in rooms for babies), Pretzel sticks. Electric kettle, tea and coffee set (refreshed once daily). Table service in all units (except the patisserie). 24-hour open à la carte Bistro. 24-hour beverage service. Inclusive beverage service during breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Hot and cold coffee varieties and croissants at the Coffee Kiosk. Freshly squeezed seasonal fruit and vegetable juices and detox drinks at the Vitamin Bar. Gözleme House offers various gözleme options. Patisserie services. Buffet-style breakfast, lunch, and dinner in the main restaurant. Mini Club offers buffet lunch and dinner. Grilled dishes served on charcoal in the main restaurant. Detox drink station in the main restaurant. Healthy and diet food corner in the main restaurant. Children's and baby buffet in the main restaurant. Vegan buffet in the main restaurant. Freshly squeezed orange juice at breakfast. Use of Tetra Pak packaged fruit juices at all beverage units. Grilled dishes, pizza, pide, hamburger, and similar snacks at the Snack restaurant. Ice cream service. Live music or themed entertainment at some à la carte restaurants. Accompanying snacks (chips, nuts, cheese, etc.) with all beverage services. Mobile food and drink service at pools and beach (fruit, boiled corn, lemonade, sangria, etc.). Beer garden with cold draft beers and shelled peanuts. Beverages at bars.

chunks.text_en:
MINI BAR CONCEPT  
The mini bar is free of charge and replenished daily.  
Non-alcoholic beverages (Cola, Diet Cola, Sprite, Fanta), water, mineral water, beer, hot drinks service (kettle, coffee, tea, herbal tea, powdered milk, sugar), chips or crackers, and fruit juice are available.  

A'LA CARTE RESTAURANTS  
A'la carte restaurant service is reservation-based and incurs a fee.  
Vivaldi Restaurant, The Mariner Fish Restaurant, and Sofra Turkish A'la Carte Restaurant are charged at 15 EUR per person.  
Muzoyaki Sushi A'la Carte Restaurant is charged at 25 EUR per person.  
Reservations for the A'la Carte restaurants are made after check-in through the Guest Relations Department.  
Dress code is mandatory at all A'la Carte restaurants.  

FOOD AND BEVERAGE SERVICE  
All-day dining at the Babylon Main Restaurant and Terrace was renovated in 2024.  
Entry to the main restaurant is not permitted with swimwear and flip-flops.  
 Dress code is required in the main restaurant.  
Freshly squeezed orange juice is served free of charge at breakfast.  
Room service is available 24 hours (charges apply).  
In the main pool area, orders can be placed via QR code.  
Local and imported alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages are included in the concept.  
The brands of beverages are determined by the hotel management.  
Premium alcoholic beverages are not included in the concept and are charged additionally.  
Bottled alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks are served at an extra cost.  
Starbucks® is included in the Dobedan Hotels' concept.

The hotel features 6 restaurants and 5 bars. RESTAURANTS: 1 Main Restaurant, 4 A La Carte Restaurants, 1 Snack Restaurant, 6 Bars, 1 Pastry Shop, and 1 Gözleme (Turkish flatbread) Station (located separately). Breakfast, late breakfast, lunch, and dinner are served buffet-style at the Main Restaurant. The Main Restaurant offers diet and vegetarian buffets. It also has a Children's Buffet and Baby Corner. High chairs are available at the Main Restaurant and all food and beverage outlets. 

The A La Carte restaurants—Mardin, La Mer, Oliva, and Sakura—allow one free usage per week-long stay with reservation; a second visit is chargeable and reservation is required. These restaurants also have children's buffets. Premium beverages (champagne, bottled wine, premium spirits) are available at an extra charge.

FREE SERVICES: The concept includes standard local alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, hot beverages, and selected imported drinks. Local drinks include all hot beverages, soft drinks, table wine, local beer, and local spirits. Imported drinks include rum, vodka, gin, whiskey, vermouth, and selected wines.

chunks.text_en:
Within the hotel, there are 2 restaurants and 2 bars. MejorCosta Bar & Lounge and Mejor Costa Beach & Lounge overlook the hotel's exclusive beach, which sparkles with shimmering white shells on the sand. The area includes a sunbathing terrace, open pools for adults and children surrounded by comfortable sunbeds and umbrellas, and a spacious, lush garden filled with giant cushions that offer a stunning view of the sea and mountains just steps from your room. At Mejor Costa Beach & Lounge, a variety of delicious snacks, exquisite flavors from the Ace Restaurant & Bar menu, and a carefully curated selection of non-alcoholic fresh drinks are served daily from 9:00 AM to 2:00 AM in a relaxed yet stylish environment, accompanied by music that enhances the ambiance. This is also the perfect place to unwind with family or friends after a perfect day spent by the sea and under the sun, enjoy a cocktail while watching the mesmerizing sunset, or end your evening with a glass of drink and let yourself be carried away by the rhythm of the music.

Our newly opened à la carte restaurant, The Counter, offers Turkish cuisine and is available for dinner from 8:00 PM to 12:30 AM. Inspired by a chef’s workbench, The Counter features both a drink and a food menu prepared with seasonal ingredients from the region. Chef Kemal Demirasal has designed a sharing-style menu that includes starters, hot appetizers, and main courses, emphasizing a dynamic and communal dining experience.

The GYM spans an area of 570 square meters and operates year-round with a team of expert trainers. It features two studios for group classes and Pilates, as well as changing rooms and shower facilities. You can work on your personal goals using cardiovascular and strength-enhancing machines, free weights, and close guidance from trainers to create an exercise routine that could transform your life.

Our specialized therapists focus on relieving tense areas, promoting holistic health, and anti-aging results, blending traditional rituals to make you feel truly special.

It includes 500 basic movements and five types of equipment, all interconnected. The Pilates sessions at Yacht Club Fitness are tailored and conducted by experts with personalized programs. These programs are designed to improve body balance and strength, correct posture, enhance conditioning, promote healthy weight loss or gain, and increase physical resilience, helping you achieve your fitness goals.

The hotel features 5 restaurants and 6 bars. A la carte reservations are made through the Guest Relations department between 09:30 and 15:30. The restaurants are open seven days a week. The hotel management determines which cuisine will be available each day. For Superior Swim-Up room types, guests staying four nights or more are entitled to one free à la carte meal. Family Swim-Up rooms offer free à la carte dining every day. 

MINI BAR CONTENT: Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta, Sparkling Water, Still Water, Cappy Fruit Juice, Efes Pilsen Beer. Mini bars are replenished daily between 09:00 and 17:00.

DETAILS: Meals in the main restaurant are served behind closed glass buffets to prevent external contact and are prepared by our chefs. Beverages are served to the table by waitstaff. Premium drinks and fresh fruit juice options are available at an additional charge.

Designed with hygiene in mind, the modern architecture includes various buffets for all meals: Soup Buffet, Salad, Cold Buffet, Children's Buffet, Hot Buffet, Wok Sushi Buffet, Street Food Buffet, Regional Flavors Buffet, Health Buffet, Grill Buffet, Pasta Buffet, Pide-Pizza-Bread Buffet, and Dessert & Fruit Buffets. Themed buffets such as Turkish Night, Italian Night, and Fish Night are held on certain evenings. 

A la carte reservations are made through the Guest Relations department between 09:30 and 15:30. The restaurant is open seven days a week. The hotel management determines which cuisine will be available each day. For Superior Swim-Up rooms, guests staying four nights or more can enjoy one free à la carte meal. Family Swim-Up rooms offer free à la carte dining every day.

The hotel features 9 restaurants and 8 bars. The property offers a selection of Zengin Premium Imported Alcoholic beverages. All restaurants serve À La Carte dining. In-room tea and coffee setups are available. Complimentary energy drinks are provided at the hotel. The hotel also offers a variety of fresh and dried pastries (patisserie), soft drinks, and alcoholic beverages. Some bars serve certain drinks bottled. Ice cream is available at various points within the hotel from 10:00 to 23:00, including branded packaged and open ice cream. Food and bottled drinks are served at the beach bar, with bottled beverages consisting of branded beers and soft drinks. All bars and the patisserie serve Turkish coffee, except for the Beach Bar and Irish Bar. The minibar includes soft drinks and beer and is replenished daily, except for beer. À La Carte restaurants serve freshly squeezed orange and pomegranate juices at breakfast.

Pools & Beach

Pools:
Relax Outdoor Pool: 1,600 m², 140 cm deep  
Water Slide Pool: 130 m², 120 cm deep, 4 x 1 lane  
Indoor Pool: 150 m², 140 cm deep  
Children's Outdoor Pool: 35 m², 40 cm deep  
Children's Indoor Pool: 15 m², 40 cm deep  
Swim-up Rooms with Private Pool: 140 m², 130 cm deep  

Our outdoor pool, with an area of 330 m², offers a variety of activities and parties throughout the day. You can enjoy the fun by the poolside or on the lawns while soaking up the sun.

Our heated indoor pool, with a surface area of 88 m², provides a peaceful environment away from noise where you can enjoy warm water. The indoor pool located in the spa area is also connected to the hotel’s garden.

Beach:
Side, the capital of the Mediterranean, boasts fine sandy, shallow beaches that are perfectly heated by the sun, in addition to its historical texture. Our hotel is just a 3-minute walk from our private beach, which provides beach towels, umbrellas, and sun loungers.

Cinema, Entertainment Center, Amusement Park, Lolitown, Board games (backgammon, okey, card games) (@Table), Play Area.

Within the facility, there are two outdoor swimming pools, one of which features a slide, a children's pool, and an indoor swimming pool. The Activation Pool, Relax Pool (a relaxation pool), and an aqua park with six slides are available. The outdoor swimming pool with slides operates with two hours of service in the morning and two hours in the afternoon. The children's pool and indoor swimming pool (with a children's section) are heated during the winter months from November 1st to March 31st. 

Daytime Animation includes: morning gym, brain games, step aerobics, stretching, table tennis, boccia, beach volleyball, water gymnastics (in the pool), water polo, pool games, darts, air rifles, and night entertainment programs featuring professional dance shows, musical shows, Turkish nights, professional evening shows, interactive games, sketches, cabaret performances, post-show activities, live music (three days a week), and various after-show events such as bingo, karaoke, and quizzes.

There is a dedicated children’s club with a specific program running from 10:00 to 16:00 for children aged 4-12, offering educational and entertaining activities, competitions, and events. Facilities include a water slide, children's pool, and playground.

SPORTS, ENTERTAINMENT & CHILDREN'S ACTIVITIES

Six days a week, various entertainment and evening animation programs are offered, including dance shows, karaoke, bingo, live music, and stage performances. The disco operates from 23:00 to 02:00 (three nights a week), with free entry and drinks.

Activities include boccia, yoga, aerobics, water aerobics, gymnastics, darts, table tennis, billiards, mini golf, basketball, foosball, squash, a fitness center, and two tennis courts.

PAID SERVICES

- Late check-out (after 12:00), subject to availability
- 24-hour room service
- Bottle service
- Hairdresser
- Laundry
- Telephone and fax

The hotel features 11 restaurants and 12 bars. Hilton Gourmet Main Restaurant (with separate adult and children areas), 6 à la carte restaurants, 2 snack restaurants, 12 bars, 1 patisserie, a beachside delicacies/beach snack area, fruit service around the pool and beach (June, July, August), and a vegan and gluten-free product buffet in the main restaurant. 

24-hour room service, ice cream service (lunch and dinner at the main restaurant, Macaron Patisserie, Breeze snack, Vento snack, Carpi Kidz Paradise). The minibar is refreshed daily and includes soft drinks: 2 Coca-Cola, 1 Cola Zero, 1 Sprite, 1 Fanta, 2 Efes beers, 2 iced teas, 2 sparkling waters, and 4 still waters.

ALL-INCLUSIVE CONCEPT:
- All hot beverages
- Soft drinks and bottled fruit juices
- Domestic beers
- Selected table wines at all restaurants and bars
- Vodkas, rums, whiskeys, gins, tequilas, konyak & brandy, liqueurs, appetizers
- Standard minibar (refreshed daily): soft drinks (2 Coca-Cola, 1 Cola Zero, 1 Sprite, 1 Fanta, 2 beers, 1 iced tea, 4 waters)

Freshly squeezed orange juice is complimentary at breakfast in the main restaurant.  
Room service is available 24 hours and is chargeable.  
Local and some foreign non-alcoholic beverages are included in the concept.  
Drink brands are determined by the hotel management.  
Premium alcoholic beverages are served at an extra charge.  
Bottled alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks are served at an extra charge.  
Starbucks® service is included in the concept.  

**During the winter season, Dobedan Beach Bar operates only depending on weather conditions.**

The building is 100 meters away from the beach.  
Beach Structure: Sand, 60 meters wide, 100 meters long.

Interactive Water Slide Children’s Pool: 30 m³ volume / 30 cm depth / children’s section / heated.

Pool heating dates are determined by the hotel management.  
The sea water pool located within the SPA center is subject to an extra fee.

The hotel features 3 restaurants and 4 bars. 

Restaurants & Bars:
- Main Restaurant – "Main Restaurant" (850 pax): Buffet breakfast (07:00-10:00), late breakfast (10:00-10:30), lunch (12:30-14:30), and dinner (18:30-21:00). Night soup (23:30-00:00).
- "Spice" A la Carte Restaurant (19:00-21:00): Offers special flavors resulting from the fusion of Asian cuisine with international tastes.
- "Saray" A la Carte Restaurant (19:00-21:00): Serves unique dishes blending Turkish cuisine with international flavors.
- "Prima Cucina" A la Carte Restaurant (19:00-21:00): Features special Italian dishes with international influences.

For stays of 7 nights or more, guests are entitled to one free reservation, which must be made in advance through the kiosk.

Bars:
- Beach Bar (10:00-18:00): Selected local alcoholic and non-alcoholic hot and cold beverages.
- Buddha Bar (10:00-00:00): Local alcoholic and non-alcoholic hot and cold beverages; premium and imported alcoholic drinks are available at an extra charge.
- Lobby Bar (10:00-01:00): Local alcoholic and non-alcoholic hot and cold beverages; premium and imported alcoholic drinks are available at an extra charge.

chunks.text_en:
The hotel features 3 restaurants and 4 bars. The Half Board option includes the right to select 4 items from the menu for dinner per adult guest. Beverages are not included in this package, and dinner is served at Anda Restaurant.

GASTRONOMY
Cape Bodrum Luxury Hotel & Beach offers an open buffet breakfast hall serving local, regional, and organic flavors, Anda Restaurant with hints of Aegean and Mediterranean cuisine, three signature bars located at different points with unique concepts and standout drinks, and Artisan Cafe, a meeting point for desserts and enjoyable conversations. These venues are ideal for guests seeking gourmet experiences and new tastes, serving as essential stops for culinary delights and feasts.

LOBBY LOUNGE
Located on the hotel's ground floor, the Lobby Bar Lounge operates 24 hours a day. Guests can enjoy short, pleasant breaks throughout the day, watch the sunset over the deep blue Aegean Sea, and indulge in exquisite flavors and refreshing drinks on the open or indoor terrace.

LOTUS KITCHEN BREAKFAST LOUNGE
This breakfast restaurant, situated on the same floor as the infinity pool, serves from 07:30 to 12:00. It offers a panoramic view of Gündoğan Bay and provides an open or covered terrace where guests can enjoy local and organic flavors. Start your day with a traditional Turkish breakfast or international options to energize yourself.

INFINITY POOL BAR
Open from 09:30 to 20:00, the Infinity Pool Bar offers a unique experience where the infinity pool meets the sea and horizon. Guests can relax and enjoy a variety of drinks while taking in the stunning views.

chunks.text_en: There is 1 restaurant and 3 bars within the hotel. MAIN RESTAURANT The main restaurant features a diet buffet, and all beverages are served to the tables. Breakfast includes a filtered coffee option. Every evening, different themed dinners are offered with varied presentations, and ice cream is served during the meal. Breakfast, late breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night snacks are available. A LA CARTE RESTAURANT The restaurant primarily serves seafood, local Mediterranean dishes, and regional specialties. Its location overlooking the private beach allows guests to enjoy the Mediterranean view, watching the colors of the sea and sky change at sunset while savoring their meals. The White Beach Club offers international cuisine and operates on specific days. BARS Lobby Bar: Serves standard alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks from 10:00 to 19:00, including premium coffee varieties and imported & premium beverages (charges apply). The White Pool Bar: Open from 00:00 to 00:00, serving non-alcoholic drinks; from 01:00 to 10:00, it offers standard and selected imported beverages; operating hours are from 10:00 to 01:00. The White Beach Bar: Offers non-alcoholic drinks, beer, and wine. OTHER SERVICES The Lobby Bar also serves pastry products and beverages. The Coffee Corner provides various coffee types, desserts, and cold fruits. Ice cream is available by the poolside. SNACKS The White Beach offers a variety of snacks and a salad buffet. Pool Snack House serves gozleme and hamburger varieties. NOTES The locations and operating hours of the units may vary depending on seasonal conditions. The A la carte restaurant may close due to weather or open only on specific days of the week. Reservations are required one day in advance. Every evening offers different themed dinners with varied presentations, and ice cream is served during the meal. Breakfast, late breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night snacks are available. The restaurant mainly serves seafood, local Mediterranean dishes, and regional specialties. Its location overlooking the private beach provides a stunning Mediterranean view, allowing guests to enjoy the sunset and the changing colors of the sea and sky while dining.

chunks.text_en:
White City Beach has a private pier and various food and beverage facilities on its beach. Access to the beach is provided via an underpass, which is 50 meters away. Sunbeds, cushions, and umbrellas on the beach are free of charge; the beach surface is a mixture of sand and pebbles. Water shoes are recommended.

POOLS:
- Open Swimming Pool: 250 m² / 140 cm deep
- Indoor Swimming Pool: 35 m² / 130 cm deep
- Outdoor Jacuzzi Pool: 16 m² / 30 cm deep

There are 2 water slides in the aquapark.

NOTES:
Around the pools and beach, fast foods, snacks, cold fruits, cold drinks, and coolers are served at various times and locations. Umbrellas, cushioned sunbeds, and sun loungers at the beach and poolside are provided free of charge. Towel exchange on the same day is subject to a fee. The opening hours of the aquapark and pools may vary depending on the season.

chunks.text_en: During your stay at The Yalı Konak Hotel, you can enjoy a variety of activities. Located in the city center and close to all parts of the city, The Yalı Konak Hotel offers easy access to must-see natural and historical sites. The historic Kemeraltı Bazaar, Kılarağası Han, Clock Tower, Agora Ancient City, İzmir International Fair & Recreation Areas, Konak Ferry Terminal, and İzmir Kordon are all just a 5-minute drive from the hotel. While exploring these famous tourist spots in İzmir, you can browse historic markets, shops, and malls, take photos, and sample the famous street foods. You can unwind at the finest fish restaurants along the Kordon. Enjoy a walk along Göztepe Coastal Boulevard at any hour and take in the sunset. Don't miss visiting the İnciraltı City Forest, located 10 km away. After a scenic forest walk, you can enjoy fish sandwiches on the İnciraltı beach or on a boat. We also highly recommend visiting the İnciraltı Marine Museum, a historic maritime museum displaying objects related to the social, historical, and economic development of seafaring. At the İnciraltı Pier, three museum ships are moored, showcasing exhibits on maritime history.

chunks.text_en:
Approximately 430 meters long, the public sandy-fine pebble beach features free sunbeds and cushions. Beach towel exchange is available with a card issued at the reception upon entry; towel changes are made daily at the towel station. There are sunbeds, umbrellas, restrooms, and showers on the beach. The pavilion requires a reservation and is paid. It has received the Blue Flag environmental award.

Pools:
- One outdoor pool (9,600 m² / 10,800 m³ / depth: 150 cm), with two slides for adults.
- One children's pool (45 m² / 13.5 m³ / depth: 30 cm), with three slides for children. The outdoor pool also features a pirate ship with slides for kids.
- One indoor pool (463 m² / 649 m³ / depth: 145 cm).
- One indoor children's pool (8 m² / 3 m³ / depth: 30 cm).

Sunbeds, umbrellas, restrooms, showers, and changing rooms are available. Beach towels are free of charge. Sunbeds cannot be reserved in the main pool before 07:00.

Aqua Park:
- Total area: 7,500 m²
- Tower height: 17 meters
- Two drop pools (depth: 120 cm)
- One drop pool (depth: 180 cm)
- One children's water park (depth: 40 cm)
- Total slides: 13, including Super Drop, Space Bowl, Boomerango, Windigo (4-lane slide), Uphill, Rafting Slide, Black Hole, Hill, Aqua Tube, and Body Slide.
- Important: Children under 120 cm are not allowed to slide on Super Drop, Space Bowl, and Boomerango.

The hotel features 1 restaurant and 4 bars.  
RESTAURANTS: The restaurant has a capacity of 450 people. Turkish and international cuisine, breakfast, lunch, and dinner are served as open buffet free of charge.  
BARS: Pool Bar, Lobby Bar, Restaurant Bar.  

CONCEPT INFORMATION:  
Turkish and international cuisine, breakfast, lunch, and dinner are offered as open buffet free of charge.  
All drinks are chargeable after 23:00.  
All local alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages consumed between 10:00 and 23:00 are free of charge.  
Turkish coffee is charged.  
Freshly squeezed fruit juice is charged.  
Imported drinks and mixed drinks made with them are charged.  
After 23:00, all domestic and foreign beverages are chargeable.  
The Lobby Bar is free until 23:00; after that, it is chargeable.  

ALL-INCLUSIVE:  
Start / End Time: 10:00 - 23:00

chunks.text_en:
The hotel features 2 restaurants and 4 bars.  
RESTAURANTS  
There are two restaurants at Forever Club: an outdoor restaurant with a capacity of 500 people and an indoor restaurant for 350 guests. These wonderful restaurants, offering stunning sea views, serve buffet meals at designated times for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The restaurants are self-service, but the waitstaff are happy to take your drink orders.  
Poolside fast-food restaurants also operate with a rich menu and are available throughout the day. The Italian and Fish Restaurants offer delicious dishes with magnificent sea views and sunsets.  

BARS  
The hotel has 4 separate bars, including Monachus Cafe, which offers spectacular views and operates 24 hours a day. There is also a poolside snack bar, a beach bar, and during evening animation programs, the Pool Bar serves a variety of cocktails.  

All-Inclusive Concept  
From 08:00 to 24:00, all local alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages are included.  
Between 08:00 and 24:00, imported drinks and all beverages served after midnight are chargeable.  
The Italian Restaurant and Fish Restaurant are reservation-based and all drinks are paid separately.  

Other services included in the All-Inclusive Program:  
Pool, animation activities, ping-pong, billiards, backgammon, okey, TV, Turkish bath, sauna, fitness center, beach towels, sunbeds, umbrellas.  

Services not included in the All-Inclusive Program:  
All drinks from 00:00 to 08:00, all imported beverages throughout the day, all bottled drinks, freshly squeezed fruit juices, mini-market, hairdresser, photography, doctor, spa center, massage/peeling.

At the hotel's distinguished restaurant, you can enjoy carefully prepared flavors presented with modern plating, allowing you to delight in the elegance of Mediterranean cuisine. Its warm atmosphere and impeccable service promise an unforgettable culinary journey. The restaurant offers a rich gastronomic experience reflecting the fresh breeze of the Mediterranean. There are open buffet options catering to all tastes, hot and cold dishes made with fresh local ingredients, and select flavors from world cuisines. Daily menus prepared with the chefs' special touches make your holiday not only relaxing but also full of delicious surprises.  

The hotel's bars provide a lively atmosphere with beverage options suitable for any time of day. You can enjoy refreshing drinks at the pool bar or access high-quality coffee varieties and special cocktails throughout the day at the lobby bar. Hotel Golden Sun’s dining culture offers a careful experience that combines comfort and flavor, adding value to your holiday.  

Local alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks are served unlimited at the bars. All beverages are served in glasses, not bottles. Fresh fruit juices and all bottled drinks are available at an extra charge. Imported alcoholic beverages and selected cocktails are also available at an additional cost. Turkish coffee is served at an extra fee. If the service staff observes guests abusing alcohol, they reserve the right not to serve alcoholic beverages for health reasons.

chunks.text_en: At Mandarin & Mango Hotel, spacious and comfortable rooms, a tasteful and cozy atmosphere, and peaceful moments away from formality await you. We are genuinely passionate about and respectful of nature’s blue skies, greenery, flowers, and insects, and we take pride in welcoming your beloved pets as your friends. Your hosts and our self-proclaimed safety and quality inspector, our dog Pasha, will do everything they can—and more—to make you feel at home. Your days will begin with a rich breakfast served with homemade jams, pastries, and village eggs, among many other options. As the day winds down, you can enjoy homemade sweet and savory treats alongside your afternoon tea, delighting your palate. For dinner, a carefully curated atmosphere and attentive service will ensure memorable moments. Our menu features a wide selection of dishes made with fresh, organic ingredients. That’s why our half-board rates are even more advantageous.

Salt Room Therapy: For a healthy lifestyle, our facility offers a 25 m² salt room therapy made from European standard, unrefined A-grade crystal 84-mineral mountain salt. This natural therapy provides accelerated treatment for conditions such as asthma, bronchitis, COPD, upper respiratory issues, psoriasis, eczema, and especially stress.

Hippo Therapy (Horse Therapy): We offer free initial riding and therapy sessions for children with and without disabilities using our specially trained pony in the garden.

Activities include free bicycle rentals available at the facility, allowing you to explore nearby mountain villages. To enjoy the beauty of Mount Kazdağı, you can join a jeep safari tour to Sarıkız summit and Altınoluk Canyon, or take a pleasant nature walk to Hasanboğuldu Sütüven Waterfall, located 3 km from the hotel, through scenic trails. Guided nature walks are available on seven different routes, if desired.

Additionally, you can experience the Kazdağı cultural tour, which includes visits to Kızılkeçili village, Hasanboğuldu Sütüven Waterfall, Tahtakuşlar Museum, Zeus Altar in Adatepe, the ancient city of Antandros in Altınoluk, and the village of Yeşilyurt, with return.

chunks.text_en:
Hot Air Balloon Rides
Discover the fairy chimneys, mysterious valleys, and extensive vineyards where the region's delicious wines are produced, all from the sky. This will be an experience you will never regret, and one you will never forget. These balloon tours, which are symbols of Cappadocia, are the most effective way to see the area's unique beauty.

Turkish Night
Enjoy a delightful Turkish night at Cappadocia’s historic underground restaurant, where you can watch local performances and immerse yourself in regional culture. Join us for an approximately three-hour enjoyable evening. You can choose Turkish Night programs with or without dinner.

Trekking
These special walking tours, called trekking, take you to the heart of Cappadocia’s mystical village life. Wander through cobblestone alleyways, small towns and villages carved from rocks, hidden churches and dovecotes in the valleys; all of these will transport you to a different world. As you progress along the trails, you’ll wonder, “What will I discover this time?”

chunks.text_en:
When you think of Alaçatı, you imagine a place filled with beautiful natural riches throughout all four seasons. The air is pure, and the sea is crystal clear. Narrow streets, stone houses with bay windows, windmills—Alaçatı is one of the world's most important surfing destinations. 

What to do in Alaçatı? Stroll through its narrow cobblestone streets and among its stone houses. Enjoy the rich gourmet cuisine of the Aegean region. Try the mastic ice cream. Have a coffee at a café with blue shutters. Explore the local markets. Alaçatı is just a 1-minute walk from Morino.

chunks.text_en:
Dionysos Menu
Prepared with the finest examples of modern and traditional Turkish cuisine, the Dionysos menu features dishes made from products naturally grown on our own farm. These are served to your table by chefs trained by award-winning Chef Didem Şenol... You are invited on a magical flavor journey in the embrace of nature.

Dionysos Terrace
In the unique Kumlubük view, we welcome guests with special Mediterranean flavors at our Al Fresco restaurant.

Nar
Breakfast is served between 08:00 and 10:30.
Once a week, the gourmet restaurant Nar offers a tasting menu called "Flavors from Turkey" for up to 16 people.

Dionysos Bar
Local and imported drinks, freshly squeezed fruit juices, and a variety of teas and coffees.

Food & Wine Experiences

Olive Oil Tasting
Visit the olive oil pressing workshop to learn how Amos’s special olive oil is produced and enjoy a tasting. Don’t forget to take home a complimentary bottle of Amos olive oil!

Indoor Restaurant, Outdoor Restaurant, Pool Bar, Mare Beach Bar, Mare Cafe, Mare Beach A La Carte Restaurant  

Breakfast is served as an open buffet by the poolside, accompanied by bougainvillea and sea views.  
Dinner for half-board guests is offered as a complimentary set menu at Mare Beach Restaurant, available either on the platform or on the sandy beach, with the sparkling sea and candlelight creating a romantic atmosphere.  

Throughout the day, guests can enjoy Turkish and international flavors at the Mare Beach A La Carte Restaurant for an additional fee.  

- 08:00-10:00: Open Buffet Breakfast, Poolside  
- 20:00-22:00: Set Menu Dinner  
- 11:00-22:00: Mare Beach A La Carte Restaurant – Paid service  
- 10:00-19:00: Mare Cafe – Paid service  
- 10:30-22:30: Room Service – Paid service  

The minibar is filled once upon check-in with water for each guest.  
Depending on the number of guests, the hotel may also serve breakfast as a set menu.  

During meals, beverages are charged separately.

chunks.text_en:
Within the hotel, there are 2 restaurants and 4 bars. EZİ offers a comfortable and stylish environment with an enriched menu, serving guests breakfast from the garden along with fresh fruit juices, healthy drinks, smoothies, and a variety of coffees. Afterwards, it is the perfect place to relax with sunset views and snacks throughout the evening, as well as private cabanas around the infinity pool. OPEN DAILY: 07:00 – 23:00

MALVA RESTAURANT
Pause at Malva, listed in the Michelin Guide 2025, and unwind with a leisurely meal. Offering the fresh local flavors of the Aegean with delicious dishes, the menu features micro-local and vegan concepts that leave a lasting impression on the palate. In the evenings, DJ performances create a perfect ambiance. Closed on Mondays. Open Tuesday to Sunday: 07:00 AM – 12:00 AM

MALVA COCKTAIL BAR
Sunset views provide an ideal backdrop for enjoying your favorite drink. Sip expertly crafted cocktails and choose from a selection of unique local and international wines. OPEN DAILY: 07:00 AM – 12:00 AM

SUYAH POOL CLUB
Seasonal signature cocktails, special menus prepared with fresh Aegean ingredients, and DJ performances await guests to experience the nostalgic summer vibe. The music gradually picks up from midday, creating lively sunset moments in the evening. OPEN DAILY: 11:00 – 19:00

FAMILY BEACH CLUB
With a rich menu served from the garden, the Family Beach Club offers guests breakfast with fresh fruit juices, healthy drinks, smoothies, and a variety of coffees in a comfortable and stylish setting. Later, enjoy sunset views, snacks throughout the evening, and relaxation in private cabanas around the infinity pool. OPEN DAILY: 07:00 – 23:00

With its breathtaking view showcasing the unique beauty of Cennet Bay, Akana Restaurant offers a culinary journey that awakens all your senses. You can start your day with a healthy, fresh, and enjoyable breakfast prepared with natural and local products, along with rich aromatic coffees. 

Accompanied by the gentle breeze bringing the fragrant scent of the Aegean Sea and the sounds of birds, you can indulge in flavors that go beyond traditional menus—from the fresh olive oils of the Aegean to Mediterranean cuisine, from world flavors to sushi. Additionally, you can experience our irresistible specialties such as stone-baked pide, lahmacun, and other exclusive delicacies crafted for the day.

We present our extensive menu with freshness and flavor preserved at the moment of first cooking through special catering packaging, delivered directly to your boat.

Su is the initial stage of everything in existence. Coming from the endless waters of the Mediterranean, Akana represents the life cycle initiated by water. Akana Cennet Koyu Beach, with its crystal-clear waters and enchanting atmosphere inherited from ancient Ephesus, invites you to experience Akana’s life cycle. The horizon blends the golden and pink hues of the sun with the endless blue where sky and sea meet, offering you Akana Beach. This experience evolves into a journey far beyond what your five senses can perceive—a story of self-discovery. 

Akana Beach, with its natural designs complemented by wooden and straw elements, features spacious seating areas with large cushions, low tables surrounded by soft pillows, comfortable sun loungers, and daytime snacks accompanied by all-day music streaming, creating a harmonious whole that prepares you for a delightful evening.

From sunrise to sunset, Akana Beach invites you to experience a very special, beachfront cove in Bodrum, Cennet Koyu, offering a truly unique experience.
